cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I believed the cupboard before it learned to speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. One quick acknowledgment, then I'll respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An informed opinion formed over years of my support.

mechanism: A manages an interviewer's framing so the cupboard's criticism becomes evidence of A's earlier support for its impossible speech.
confusable: Merely accepting a talking object misses D153's demand for priority; S03 must shape how that credit is recorded.
comparison: A difficult subject requesting silence differs from dating a public drawing.
seedUse: Keep years of support and talk-too-much criticism; give B a concrete reporting task so A's correction has a target.
